description: A Java interface defining a builder pattern for creating and modifying AccessControlList objects, with methods for setting, removing, and building ACL entries.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the given AclEntry in the builder, replacing any existing entry with the same authorization subject.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple AclEntries in the builder, replacing entries with the same authorization subjects.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific AclEntry from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the builder by its AuthorizationSubject.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all entries with authorization subjects matching those in the provided iterable.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList from the current builder state.
